changelog:
v1.25.0 - Group all halftone settings in a styled panel, replace boundary checkbox with slider, make color modes vibrant and distinct, and reposition Reset button to bottom.
v1.24.7 - Fix manga dither dither color modes (One Color, Chroma Bleeding, Complementary Tinting) rendering all black by decoupling dot color calculations from zeroed shadow clamp settings.
v1.24.6 - Fix Pause Menu settings dropdown clickability and CheckBox layout visibility bugs by flattening nested container hierarchies.
